listing_terms.how_to_apply: POST your tool to /tools/apply, then open the GitHub issue link it returns (one click, pre-filled). Listings are curated — junk gets delisted.
listing_terms.listing_toll_note: The first 10 third-party tools list FREE as founding tools. After that, a one-time 1 USDC listing toll (x402, Base) activates the listing.
listing_terms.per_call: In v1, tool developers run their own x402 toll at their own endpoint and keep 100% of per-call payments. TrollBridge never touches your call revenue — it only charges the listing toll.
requirements: A live HTTPS endpoint agents can call
Your own x402 toll on that endpoint (any price you set, USDC on Base)
A working payTo wallet you control
A real description of what the tool does — no vapor
